div.div: The diagnostic must enter Idle sleep to complete and wait for the Done interrupt to wake up the device. If a diagnostic is in progress, the interrupt handler must clear the done flag in order to exit the ISR and signal to the diagnostic that the the diagnostic is complete in case another interrupt source woke up the device. In that case, the diagnostic will re-enter Idle sleep.
